Retains original damage and blood storage: eligible direct hits store 30% of actual damage. At 60 blood, spend 60 to heal you and the nearest other colonist within 12 cells, at most once per hit. Branches require the original blood release to actually restore another colonist's recoverable injuries. Full health, shields and other healing do not count. Grants no abilities.
After the original blood release actually heals another colonist, store one afterglow for 6 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary enemy hit spends it for 75 base damage. The generating hit, abilities and secondary damage cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 75.
Within 10 seconds, the original blood releases must actually heal two different other colonists. Then heal 20 base points on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. You do not count, and repeated recipients neither count nor extend the window. Base rewards: healing 20.
After Blood Afterglow deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. With no recoverable injuries, no healing is stored or redirected to you. Base rewards: healing 20.
After Blood Afterglow deals actual bonus damage, leave a fixed blood echo at the impact cell. After 1 second, deal 25 base damage each to up to two enemies within 2 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. The cell does not follow targets. Base rewards: damage 25.
After Blood Circulation actually restores extra injuries, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The original blood release or blood storage alone grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
After Blood Circulation actually restores extra injuries, shield the nearest other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Never shields you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
